        AssistantORM.assistant_id == resolved_assistant_id,
        or_(AssistantORM.user_id == user.identity, AssistantORM.user_id == "system"),

    thread_id=thread_id,
    assistant_id=resolved_assistant_id,
    user_id=user.identity,
    input=request.input,
    status=initial_status,
